subject: AegisAudit connector: evidence mapping & attestation relay
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@aegisaudit.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AegisAudit connector: evidence mapping & attestation relay

Hi Julie —

Thanks again for agreeing to kick off the integration pilot. We sketched a lightweight evidence relay pattern that should let AegisAudit pull SOC2 artifacts from our evidence staging area while preserving tenant-level isolation and auditability. High-level asks below so we can align on scope for the pilot: 

- Evidence types: SOC2 artifacts (system config exports, policy docs, pen test reports, redacted logs), signed attestations for each bundle.
- Relay mechanism: short-lived S3 staging bucket per requested export (HMAC-signed manifest + objects).
- Authentication: ephemeral STS credentials with limited KMS decrypt scope; we prefer a role assumption pattern rather than permanent keys.
- Retention/TTL: objects expire after 48 hours by default; longer windows negotiable per request.
- Verification: we will include a manifest.json with SHA256 checksums and an attestations.pdf signed by our security approver.

Attached: aegis-integration-spec.pdf and SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx for mapping our artifact names to your intake fields. Can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow?

1) AegisAudit intake field names for pen-test reports and whether you require original PDF or a redacted summary first-pass.
2) Your preferred S3 region and expected retry logic if object fetch fails mid-transfer.
3) Any additional compliance breadcrumb metadata you need (e.g., redaction tokens, auditor signature fields).

If helpful, we can run a 30-min technical sync tomorrow afternoon. Karthik and Neha are on copy to coordinate the runtime hooks.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0189

Attachments: aegis-integration-spec.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Julie Park <julie@aegisaudit.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: integrations@aegisaudit.com
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AegisAudit connector: evidence mapping & attestation relay

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear spec. AegisAudit can consume the manifest + object set from S3. Quick answers: 

1) Intake fields: pen_test_report_original (PDF), pen_test_summary (TXT), tester_signature (string), report_date (YYYY-MM-DD). We can accept a redacted summary for initial triage but will request the original PDF for attestation once the customer signs the transfer.
2) Preferred region: us-west-2. For retries, our agent will do three exponential retries and then email the configured contact. If the transfer partially fails we mark the export as "incomplete" and request a re-issue.
3) Breadcrumb metadata: include redaction_token and attestation_signer fields in the manifest. We also prefer the manifest to have an ISO-8601 signed_at field.

We reviewed the matrix and it looks straightforward. We have a small security checklist on our side (I attached the minimal requirements inline — see integration checklist). I can do a 30-min sync tomorrow at 2:30pm PT to walk the team through our intake.

—Julie
Julie Park
Head of Integrations
AegisAudit
julie@aegisaudit.com

Attachments: aegis_integration_checklist.txt (text/plain)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: AegisAudit pilot - tasks & infra notes

Folks —

Summary of what I captured from Julie's reply and the spec:

- Action 1 (Infra): Create per-export staging bucket template in us-west-2 with lifecycle rule (48h expiry) + server-side encryption with our KMS key rw-inference-evidence. Buckets should be created with ACL private and pre-signed object URLs disabled (we will use role-based GET).
- Action 2 (Auth): Implement STS AssumeRole flow where AegisAudit can call AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity via their integrations principal. Short-lived creds should have kms:Decrypt for specific data keys only.
- Action 3 (Manifest): Add fields requested: redaction_token, attestation_signer, signed_at (ISO-8601), checksums (sha256). Include an objects[] array (filename, size, checksum) in the manifest.
- Action 4 (Pen Test): For pen test reports, mark as pen_test_report_original (original PDF) and pen_test_summary (redacted text). We will include a flagged field in the manifest if a legal review is required before release.

I'll spin up a draft S3 policy and manifest schema and post to the partner docs. ETA: internal draft by tomorrow morning. Neha — can you confirm with Security on the role assumption pattern and KMS scope? Laura — can you prepare a short customer-facing FAQ for the pilot covering retention, redaction, and who to contact for re-requests?

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Integrations Engineer
